messages:
Maria (ML): Quick intake — Product wants Asteria-28B as a candidate for the convo-summarization pilot. They asked for ~200ms p95 on 4k contexts. Can we quickly score this for priority?
Kenji (Infra): What quant plan / kernel availability? 28B dense can be OK if we have a 4-bit float kernel or q4_k.
Maria (ML): Vendor supplied model; no quant recipe yet. Product flagged TeleLink pilot — low latency, predictable cost.
Samir (Product): TeleLink is willing to commit to dedicated if perf lines up. Pilot target ~500k req/mo.
Esther (Eval): Need an eval matrix: SummAcc, long-context F1, hallucination rate, and a few RLHF alignment checks. Also run a small prompt perturbation suite.
Ashley (SRE): If Dedicated is required, need a capacity estimate (GPUs, mem, autoscale behavior). Who's owning that estimate?
Kenji (Infra): Rough ballpark: on A100-80GB with q4-like kernel we might get ~30 tok/s. On H100 with flash kernels maybe 45 tok/s. Still need an actual run.
Maria (ML): Proposed short scoring rubric — please react/vote inline.
Maria (ML): ```
Scoring (0-5) per axis:
- Business impact (telemetry/commit): 0-5
- Eval delta vs baseline (we use L2-13B baseline): 0-5 (positive = better)
- Quant robustness (expected drop after 4-bit/PTQ): 0-5
- Ops readiness (model size, deps, 3rd-party binaries): 0-5
- Infra cost multiplier: penalty -2..0 (higher cost => negative)
Total max: 23. Pass threshold: 14.
```
Kenji (Infra): My quick scores: Business 4, Eval delta 3 (untested), Quant robustness 2 (unknown), Ops 3, infra penalty -1 => Total = 11 (below pass).
Esther (Eval): I can run the quick eval harness tomorrow morning and simulate PTQ drops with our noise model. Expect initial numbers by EOD PST.
Samir (Product): Roadmap note — if <14, deprioritize unless TeleLink signs a short dedicated commit. They said 3 months is plausible.
Maria (ML): Action items: @Esther run eval + quant sim; @Kenji do a perf smoke on our PTQ/flash kernels with a 1k warmup; @Ashley produce a dedicated capacity estimate. Reconvene Thu 10am PT to decide.
Kenji (Infra): I'll attempt PTQ with our prototype pipeline. FYI PTQ caused a mem spike on a different 28B last week, may need spaced rollout.
ci-bot: Build triggered: run/eval-asteria-28b-quick-1 (artifact will post here when done).
Esther (Eval): :thumbsup: starting the suite now, will attach CSV and short notes.
Samir (Product): Added TeleLink brief to roadmap docs: https://redwood.example.com/roadmap/telelink — includes revenue sensitivity and SLA ask.
Ashley (SRE): I'll add an ops fallback: if Asteria fails, auto-route to L2-13B with degraded latency but preserved availability. Need to confirm cost delta.
Maria (ML): Thanks everyone — marking provisional priority = "medium" until eval + perf land. If numbers look good we escalate to "high" and open a Dedicated slot PR.
Kenji (Infra): Note: if eval shows >7% drop after 4-bit, re-eval quant strategies (QAT or mixed-precision) before committing infra.
Esther (Eval): CSV upload + short summary will be here in ~2 hours.
Maria (ML): Great. We'll close the loop Thu.
